settings.content: The controls below set exact H1–H6 and body sizes. Mobile applies below 750px. Line height is a multiplier of font size; letter spacing controls the space between characters. These sizes override the legacy scale controls above. Large display sizes use H1 typography with larger size ratios.
Applies to theme buttons, including slideshow and product buttons. Mobile settings apply below 750px.

settings.label: Fixed width
settings.info: Used when Fixed width is selected. Buttons shrink to fit narrow containers.

settings.label: Product image ratio
settings.info: Applies across product cards, including Featured collection. Fixed ratios give images equal heights within a row and may crop them. Use section setting keeps each section’s image ratio.
